description: One VPC's front door. Terminates TLS for the gateways and picks a replica inside its own Network. Holds no tenant state — no keys, users, groups, usage or catalog — so an ingress compromise leaks no API keys.

fields.description: The one VPC this ingress fronts. It reaches those replicas privately and no others, so this is set once — a box cannot change which network it is inside.
fields.label: Network

fields.description: A latency label the gateway sorts networks by, not a routing key — several Networks can share a region.
fields.label: Region

fields.description: The agent that scrapes this box. Blank = not scraped.
fields.label: Monitoring Agent

fields.description: Where the control plane pushes this ingress's replica table. Derived from this box's name inside the Fleet Zone once one is set (https, /grove-admin), else from its public IP over plain http.
fields.label: Admin URL

fields.description: The grove-gateway release this box last installed successfully. Written by the deploy, not typed — it is what makes a fleet running mixed versions visible.
fields.label: Agent Version

fields.description: Generated on insert. Authenticates every control-plane push, and the agent refuses to start without it.
fields.label: Admin Token

fields.description: Generated on insert. The bearer a gateway presents on the data path. Separate from the Admin Token on purpose — that one is the control plane's credential, and handing it to every gateway would give them the admin plane.
fields.label: Data Token

name: Ingress Server
